name: Character Sheet Generator
description: Generate a multi-view character reference sheet via Adobe Firefly from a single design brief, with a human consistency check before delivery.
author: hereliesaz

definitions.name: Character Sheet Generator
definitions.description: Generate a multi-view character reference sheet via Adobe Firefly from a single design brief, with a human consistency check before delivery.

agents.name: Character Design Briefer
agents.description: Fixes the identity anchors and required view/pose/expression list for the character sheet.

agents.name: Firefly Character Sheet Artist
agents.description: Generates the multi-view character sheet via Adobe Firefly from the identity anchors.

agents.name: Character Consistency Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews every view on the character sheet against the fixed identity anchors.
